import bpy, os, json, pathlib, subprocess, math
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
tower=next(o for o in bpy.data.collections['01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4'].objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower())
up=bpy.data.objects['V4 | porta entrada placeholder']; low=bpy.data.objects['V4 | CB | porta entrada']
q={'tower':[float(tower.location.x),float(tower.location.y)],'up':[float(up.location.x),float(up.location.y)],'low':[float(low.location.x),float(low.location.y)]}
work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'); py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'; script=work/'solve_radius_landing.py'
script.write_text(r'''
import numpy as np,json,sys,math
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); p=d['verts'].reshape(-1,3); q=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); t=np.array(q['tower'],float)
def angle(v): return math.degrees(math.atan2(v[1],v[0]))
def wrap(a): return (a+180)%360-180
for label,target,z0 in [('UP',np.array(q['up'],float),59.45),('LOW',np.array(q['low'],float),4.0)]:
 v0=target-t; r0=float(np.linalg.norm(v0)); a0=angle(v0); rv=np.hypot(p[:,0]-t[0],p[:,1]-t[1]); az=np.degrees(np.arctan2(p[:,1]-t[1],p[:,0]-t[0])); da=np.array([abs(wrap(float(a)-a0)) for a in az]); dz=np.abs(p[:,2]-z0)
 print(label,'CURRENT_RADIUS',round(r0,3),'CURRENT_ANGLE',round(a0,3),'TARGET_Z',z0)
 for rtol in (0.75,1.5,3.0,5.0):
  m=(np.abs(rv-r0)<=rtol)&(dz<=0.5); idx=np.where(m)[0]
  if len(idx):
   # prioritize smallest angular change then z error
   j=idx[np.lexsort((dz[idx],da[idx]))[0]]
   print(label,'RTOL',rtol,'POINT',round(float(p[j,0]),3),round(float(p[j,1]),3),'Z',round(float(p[j,2]),3),'R',round(float(rv[j]),3),'ANGLE',round(float(az[j]),3),'ANGLE_DELTA',round(float(wrap(float(az[j])-a0)),3),'MOVE',round(float(np.linalg.norm(p[j,:2]-target)),3)); break
 # best weighted preserving radius + z + angle
 score=3*np.abs(rv-r0)+4*dz+0.15*da; m=rv<150; ii=np.where(m)[0]; j=ii[np.argmin(score[ii])]; print(label,'BEST','POINT',round(float(p[j,0]),3),round(float(p[j,1]),3),'Z',round(float(p[j,2]),3),'R',round(float(rv[j]),3),'ANGLE_DELTA',round(float(wrap(float(az[j])-a0)),3),'MOVE',round(float(np.linalg.norm(p[j,:2]-target)),3))
''',encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([py,str(script),json.dumps(q)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('falha no solve radial')
print('LANDING_RADIUS_SOLVE_OK')
